paper_title: Direct limits for scalar field dark matter from a gravitational-wave detector
coupling_convention: Lambda_i^{-1} in GeV^-1 (inverse coupling energy scale for photon/electron coupling, exactly as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 2); NOT converted to dimensionless d_e
notes: First direct search for scalar field DM with a GW detector (GEO600 beamsplitter coupling). Paper sets essentially identical 95% CL limits on both the photon coupling Lambda_gamma and the electron-mass coupling Lambda_e (each assuming the other is zero), so this could equally be filed as ScalarElectron; ScalarPhoton chosen per pre-analysis hint. Numerical limit data are only available in figures (Figs. 2-3, 'available upon request'); the extracted points are from the explicit text statement 'limits up to Lambda_e, Lambda_gamma = 3e19 GeV for masses between 1e-13 and 1e-11 eV', encoded as a flat line at 1/(3e19 GeV) = 3.33e-20 GeV^-1 over that range. The full exclusion actually spans ~2e-13 to ~2.5e-11 eV (50 Hz - 6 kHz) with mass-dependent shape not captured here.
